'''Paul G. Mezey''' is a Hungarian-Canadian [[Mathematical chemistry|mathematical chemist]]. He was the Canada Research Chair in Scientific Modeling and Simulation in the Department of Chemistry at the [[Memorial University of Newfoundland]].<ref name="crc">[http://www.chairs-chaires.gc.ca/chairholders-titulaires/profile-eng.aspx?profileId=971] Canada Research Chairs website, retrieved 2018-09-07</ref> He retired from Memorial University in 2018.

He is known for the [[Localized molecular orbitals#Pipek–Mezey localization|Pipek–Mezey localization]] scheme.

==Biography==
Mezey earned a Master's degrees in chemistry, a Ph.D. in Chemistry, and a Master's degree in mathematics, all from [[Eötvös Loránd University]] in [[Budapest]], in the years 1967, 1970, and 1972 respectively. 
From 1982 to 2003, he was a professor of chemistry and mathematics at the [[University of Saskatchewan]], where he earned a D. Sc. in 1985 in mathematical chemistry. He was a faculty member at Memorial University from 2003 to 2018.

Mezey is editor in chief of the ''Journal of Mathematical Chemistry''.<ref>[https://www.springer.com/chemistry/physical+chemistry/journal/10910 J. Math. Chem. web site], Springer, retrieved 2012-02-25.</ref>

In 2003, Mezey received a Canada Research Chair; the chair was renewed for a second term 2010 and concluded in 2017.<ref>[http://today.mun.ca/news.php?news_id=5989 Paul Mezey renewed as Canada Research Chair], Meaghan Whelan, Memorial University, November 25, 2010, retrieved 2012-02-25.</ref><ref>[http://www.chairs-chaires.gc.ca/chairholders-titulaires/profile-eng.aspx?profileId=971 Chairholders: Paul G. Mezey], Canada Research Chair program, retrieved 2012-02-25.</ref>
Mezey is a foreign member of the [[Hungarian Academy of Sciences]].<ref>[http://mta.hu/members_of_has/ Members of Hungarian Academy of Sciences] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120218040930/http://mta.hu/members_of_has/ |date=2012-02-18 }}, retrieved 2012-02-25.</ref>
